brand.name: ClipForge AI
brand.description: AI-powered long-form to short-form video clipping tool for creators

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-tight

layout.marketing_page: Bento Grid (Asymmetric, wide gaps, generous padding p-12 to p-24)
layout.dashboard: Control Room Grid (Dense, functional, gap-4 to gap-6, h-full items)

surface_styles.bento_cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-900), 1px subtle border (border-white/5), no shadow. Hover: border-zinc-700/50
surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders (Technical look, border-collapse styles or right/bottom subtle borders)

components_strategy.marketing_page: Pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts, heavy customization. Overlapping elements. Use react-fast-marquee for logos.
components_strategy.dashboard: Shadcn UI (Tables, Dialogs, Select, Tabs). Flat design, minimal radius (rounded-lg).
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA must use Accent Primary (#CCFF00) with Black text. Minimal border radius (rounded-md).

hero_background.description: Abstract 3D glass shards glowing with neon yellow on deep obsidian black

bento_preview.description: Smartphone displaying a glowing audio waveform for vertical 9:16 preview

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the 'media' object URLs for all images. Do not use generic placeholders.
Implement the UI exclusively in Dark Mode (#09090B base). Do not use pure black.
Use 'Outfit' for headers and 'Manrope' for body. Import them properly in the main css or HTML layout.
The primary action buttons (Export, Upload) must use #CCFF00 (Volt Yellow) with black text. Keep border-radius minimal (rounded-md).
For the Landing Page, use generous spacing (p-16 to p-24) and implement a Bento Grid for the feature showcase.
For the Dashboard, use a dense Control Room Grid. The Video Preview must be locked in a 9:16 aspect ratio.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) to facilitate testing.
Generate realistic copywriting for all features and marketing text. Never use lorem ipsum.
